summary.text: Steve Reick, listed by Ballotpedia as Steven Reick, is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 63, in office since 2017, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois and law and graduate degrees from the University of Georgia.

paragraphs.text: Steven Reick's education, according to Ballotpedia, includes a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois and law and graduate degrees from the University of Georgia, and his profession is listed as attorney.
Reick assumed office in the Illinois House in 2017 and advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Adoption & Child Welfare, Appropriations - Pensions and Personnel, Cities & Villages, Judiciary - Civil, Personnel & Pensions, and Revenue & Finance committees, the Administrative Rules Committee and the Legislative Ethics Commission.
